name: gnark
title: gnark · zkworld
description: The gnark framework as a running submod of zkworld: its toolchain, starters and every gnark project here. Consensys' Go library for zkSNARK circuits: a Define(api) method over frontend.Variable fields. The starter ships a runner (zkworld.go) that solves the circuit with test.IsSolved; `go test` runs the native asserts.
